articles.title: The judgment bottleneck: Balancing AI and human speeds in strategy
articles.summary: Analysis now runs on AI time, but judgment still runs on human time. Three moves can help turn AI’s speed into better strategy decisions.

articles.title: Place, purpose, and the path to economic mobility
articles.summary: Where you live shapes far more than you’d think. New research points to how community, place, and connection relate to getting ahead.

articles.title: Strengthening supply chains behind US semiconductors
articles.summary: New research maps hidden upstream dependencies in the US semiconductor supply chain and outlines potential mitigation strategies to make the ecosystem more resilient.

articles.title: Getting real about AI: How AI agents are changing the economics of software engineering
articles.summary: Cognition co-founder and President Russell Kaplan explains why the next frontier of AI in software engineering is about more than writing code faster and what it takes to turn autonomous agents into measurable business value.

articles.title: The AI value curve: The economics of applying AI to existing work
articles.summary: Many organizations are still measuring AI adoption instead of value. The AI value curve helps identify where AI’s automation potential can be deployed most cost-effectively.
